title: Trans Mountain Interim Tariff No. 123
method: Downloaded official PDF. Read pages 1, 2 and 8-11. Visually checked page 2 rate table and page 8 variable-component table.
limitations: Dated schedule, not a booking quote. Base toll excludes contingent and Westridge marine fees. Shipment-specific availability is unknown.

title: CER Order TO-005-2026, Trans Mountain negotiated settlement
method: Downloaded and read the two-page order from REGDOCS Filing C41001.
limitations: Settlement effective January 1, 2027. This calculator retains the May 2026 schedule and does not model the new toll framework.

title: CER letter decision, Trans Mountain negotiated settlement
method: Downloaded letter decision from REGDOCS. Reviewed effective-date and settlement sections.
limitations: The implementation schedule and subsequent rate amendments are not imported.

title: Advancing internal trade
method: Read official explanation of internal trade barriers.
limitations: General border-tariff statement. Does not enumerate every tax, permit or government fee.

title: Trans Mountain System pipeline profile
method: Read infrastructure description and throughput methodology.
limitations: Description section dates to October 2024. Nominal capacity is not available capacity. Embedded pipeline geometries have separate licensing restrictions and are not copied.

title: Energy conversion calculators
method: Oil barrel definition is 42 U.S. gallons; volume conversion uses 0.003785411784 cubic metres per U.S. gallon.
limitations: Physical volume conversion only. No energy-content, quality or density equivalence is implied.
